verdict.rationale: Tavily is API-first: all of its core capabilities (search, extract, crawl, map, research with async retrieval and streaming) are documented as API endpoints, with Python/JS SDKs and a CLI on top. Account-level data is also exposed through API usage and per-request log endpoints. Missing for 10: no documented API for dashboard administration such as API key creation/rotation, billing or plan management, and project management; no explicit UI-parity statement; no published OpenAPI spec (probe 404); no independent corroboration of parity.
